meta.purpose: Joint test data for worktree option default behavior, isolation, branch flow, and failure recovery

assertions.isolation: Uncommitted/staged changes from session A must not appear in session B
assertions.branchFlow: Session commits must be on dedicated branch instead of base branch
assertions.mergePath: Feature branches can be merged back to base with traceable commits
assertions.recovery: Failure must leave clear logs and no unrecoverable half-created state
